disclosure: Read-only snapshot of the identified research sessions and their recorded subagents. Dialogue, tool text, and readable recorded reasoning are preserved apart from credential redaction and reversible pagination. Encrypted reasoning and encrypted messages are unavailable; no hidden reasoning is reconstructed. System/developer instructions, signatures, API request bodies, images, and unrelated sessions are excluded. Timestamps are recorded UTC where available. An unavailable entry is an editorial status label, not a quotation.
